identity.name: Hillsboro Shores
identity.notes: Hillsboro Shores is a homeowners association community in Pompano Beach, FL (Broward County). HOA fees cover management, trash removal, and water/sewer. Community features include a clubhouse, pool, and greenbelt. Note: the official community website (hillsboro-shores.org) was deactivated due to non-payment to its hosting provider, so no official fee amounts or additional details could be confirmed.
